domain.text: GitHub PR workflow automation for worker status reporting, check-ins, and protocol comments.

impressions.text: The task addressed worker status visibility when a turn ended without a protocol comment on the PR.
The worker reported implementing the requested changes and passing tests and checks in each of its three review-round updates.
Owner review first changed blind continuation to a check-in, then rejected relaying or parsing session text and specified PR protocol comments as the sole status channel.
The final worker update says check-ins are capped at two per round, with an alert after that, and that session text is no longer inspected for status.
The PR was reported merged, and the orchestrator reported CI green before owner review.

roundCauses.text: The owner requested replacing blind continuation with a check-in question.
The owner rejected the relay approach and session-text parsing, prompting the round-3 redesign around authenticated PR protocol comments.

findings.text: The worker reported passing 959 tests across 53 files, along with formatting, lint, typecheck, build, smoke, and knip checks in round 3.
The orchestrator reported the final head ready for owner review with CI green.
